head_commit.message:
Result comment: name a theorem statement mismatch, not only "Not verified"

Issue #61 (2026-10-24): the commit proved Bound (37615398 / 10000000 : ℚ), the challenge states the reduced
18807699/5000000, and Comparator stopped with "Challenge and solution theorem statement do not match". The public
comment said only "Not verified". The Lean kernel outcome now has reason statement_mismatch and the theorem name
(pattern-checked), and the issue and PR result comments add one line with the reason. The status stays
pending_review, so admission, closing and the site decision do not change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
